svg.title: Correcting myopia and hyperopia
svg.desc: Two schematic eyes keep their power fixed while a negative or positive correction moves the focus onto the retina. The model treats the correction and eye as lenses in contact. Animated motion has a static alternative for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Opposite correction lenses bring the focus onto the retina
Lenses-in-contact approximation; lens symbols are separated for readability. Eye power stays fixed.
Diverging correction is negative; converging is positive.
Illustrative motion • slowed down • cycle restarts
